name: data-table-02
description: Revenue by product, each with a bar scaled to the top product and its share of the total.

files.content:
'use client' import { BlockReady, BlockStateProvider, type BlockStatus, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { DataTable, DataTableBar, DataTableBody, DataTableCell, DataTableHead, DataTableHeader, DataTableRow, DataTableStateRows, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/data-table' import { formatCurrency, formatNumber, formatPercent, } from '@/registry/lib/dashboardblocks/format' interface ProductRow { category: string name: string revenue: number units: number } interface DataTable2Props { /** Defaults to a sentence with the total and the top product's share. */ description?: string /** Follows the total in the default description. */ period?: string /** Leave out, or pass none, to show the empty state. */ rows?: ProductRow[] status?: BlockStatus title: string } const exampleProps: DataTable2Props = { period: 'in the last 30 days', rows: [ { category: 'Displays', name: 'Studio Display 27"', revenue: 48_920, units: 112 }, { category: 'Audio', name: 'Wireless headphones', revenue: 41_370, units: 287 }, { category: 'Furniture', name: 'Ergonomic chair', revenue: 36_540, units: 84 }, { category: 'Accessories', name: 'Mechanical keyboard', revenue: 21_480, units: 179 }, { category: 'Accessories', name: 'USB-C dock', revenue: 12_960, units: 144 }, { category: 'Audio', name: 'Desk speakers', revenue: 8_730, units: 97 }, ], title: 'Revenue by product', } const share = (value: number, total: number) => formatPercent(total > 0 ? value / total : 0, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }) const DataTable2 = (props: DataTable2Props) => { const { period, rows = [], status, title } = props const sorted = [...rows].sort((a, b) => b.revenue - a.revenue) const total = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.revenue, 0) const top = sorted[0] const { description = top ? `${formatCurrency(total)} from ${rows.length} products${period ? ` ${period}` : ''}; ${top.name} brings in ${share(top.revenue, total)}.` : `No sales${period ? ` ${period}` : ''}.`, } = props return (

{title}

{description}
{`${title}: ${description}`} Product Units Revenue Share {!status && sorted.map((row) => ( {row.name} {row.category} {formatNumber(row.units)} {formatCurrency(row.revenue)} {share(row.revenue, total)} ))}
) } export { DataTable2, exampleProps as dataTable2ExampleProps, type DataTable2Props }
